Initial Claude learning/forgetting did not reread both saved files. Added an entrypoint checkpoint; the full rerun includes observed rereads in both runtimes.

A warmer German email acquired an unsupported mir recipient. Codex passed the targeted check after clarifying roles. Claude still added mir in both targeted follow-ups, including after the German-guide clarification. This fidelity failure remains open despite correct profile behavior.
limits: Small synthetic sample, selected scenarios, and no baseline or blind human study.
Current artifacts include separate hashes for the full sequence and later targeted refinements; the entire sequence was not repeated after every wording change.
Session/review-mode decisions, contradictory lasting preferences, concurrent write failures, other languages, and rendered media were not live-tested.
The synthetic snapshot fixtures preserve test evidence locally; real profile forgetting must not create such backups.
